name: Can Indirection Probe
author: vkays
description: A probe, not content. One question: do $Instigator and $Trigger survive into a canned object invoked from a damage hook? It decides whether a threat table can ship game-wide, because inlining costs 516 lines per install across 2568 generator slots and serializes per spawn, while a can costs three. Four counters decode the answer independently from STORED STATE, never the combat log, which is lossy: Fixt Probe Can Ran needs no token, Fixt Probe Trigger OK needs only $Trigger, Fixt Probe Instigator OK needs only $Instigator, and Fixt Threat Player/Ally need both together. Read them as Game Scripting Variables/<name>=<n> in the save. Uninstall before testing anything else.
